name: KhronosGroup/glslang
description: Khronos reference front end for GLSL/ESSL, partial HLSL front end, and a SPIR-V generator; the official compiler/validator used by the Vulkan ecosystem.
score_rationale: Official Khronos GLSL compiler with 3.5k stars, an essential infrastructure tool used by virtually all Vulkan and shader toolchains.
summary: Official Khronos GLSL to SPIR-V compiler
